_source: Second competitive map — the 'open vehicle map' §38 pool slot (design/07-maps.md). Built against the §37 per-map tests and terrain rules in data/terrain.json. Verified by scripts/map-check.mjs (incl. nav-grid reachability).
name: Open Steppe
_symmetryNote: Every element has a counterpart at rot(x,y) = (128-x, 128-y); central elements are self-symmetric. Travel-time and resource tests are exact by construction (§37).
tileScale: 1 tile ≈ 4 m; ranges in data/units are in these tiles.
style: open vehicle map (design/07 §38 pool slot). Almost no barriers: wide rolling ground, three small knolls, four wide runs, and an economy spread across the quarter lines. Games are decided by mobility, expansion timing, and picking fights on the move — not by holding a throat.

resources.note: p1 wood floor — safe, renewable, near-base (§04)
p1 natural-expansion ore — affordable ceiling, semi-exposed
p1 west quarter-line ore — third base, no terrain to hide behind; hold it with map presence
p2 east quarter-line ore (rot of p1 west)
p1 south quarter-line ore — deep fourth base toward the enemy half
p2 north quarter-line ore (rot of p1 south)
off-center rich ore, southwest of the middle knoll — the map's prize
off-center rich ore, northeast of the middle knoll (rot pair)

highGround.note: self-symmetric; double-ramped so neither player owns the fast way up
spotting perch over p1's third base — cheap to take, cheap to lose

chokes.note: wide western run past the west quarter-line ore — vehicle terrain end to end
wide southern run past both naturals — the raiding lane

barriers.note: shallow steppe pond, west half — the only terrain funnel on the map; nudges the west run outward

forests.note: small grove at the foot of the center knoll — the only infantry concealment near the rich ores

neutralObjectives.grants: vision + detection across the central steppe
neutralObjectives.note: on open ground — holding it means holding the middle of an open map; counters stealth raids on the quarter-line bases (§28)

neutralObjectives.grants: vision + detection across the central steppe

airspace: open — but with so little ground terrain, air's usual bypass value is lower here; ground mobility already goes everywhere (terrain.json highGround.access)

designTests._note: Mirrors terrain.json perMapTestHooks + design/07 §37; asserted by map-check.mjs.
designTests.resourceEquality: each player: 1 wood + 3 ore (natural + two quarter-line bases); off-center rich ore is a symmetric contested pair
designTests.flankAroundEveryNarrowChoke: no narrow chokes exist — every route is wide, so the requirement is vacuously met (§37)
designTests.everyPlateauHasARamp: all three knolls have ground ramps; the center knoll has two
designTests.elevatedArtilleryCannotHitBaseFromSafety: min knoll→base distance ≈ 62 tiles ≫ artillery range 9 ×1.5
designTests.reachability: only two short water segments exist; nav-grid BFS proves every resource, relay, and spawn is mutually reachable
